title: A photo editor
why: This is the one everyone wants and the one that isn't there yet. The viral AI-built Adobe clones self-report around 30% feature parity and alpha-quality bugs. A few experienced developers have built personal editors over open-source libraries, after weeks of daily fixes. A beginner should not start here. Use the free tools that already exist instead.
tool: Don't build it. Use Darktable (RAW), GIMP, or Photopea in the browser
keep: Everything. This is a 'use free software' answer, not a 'build it' answer.
